bullets.text: Easier Container Management - **Copilot** integration in **VS Code** streamlines container management with conversational commands.
Smart Holiday Shopping - **Microsoft Edge** introduces **Copilot** features for cashback, price tracking, and product insights.
Xbox Gaming Experience - Full screen gaming now available for **Windows 11** handhelds and in preview for PCs.
Web Install API Testing - **Microsoft Edge**'s new **Web Install API** allows seamless app installations from websites.
AI-Driven Security Operations - **Microsoft Defender Experts** leverage AI for enhanced SOC efficiency and threat response.
Notepad Update for Insiders - New **Notepad** features include table support and AI text streaming for enhanced usability.
Windows 11 Insider Preview - New features and Xbox full screen experience expand to more **Windows 11** devices.
Gartner Leader Recognition - **Microsoft** named a Leader in the 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Access Management.
